subject: Supplier registry activation: Acquitech profile and PO routing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: vendors@acquitech.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier registry activation: Acquitech profile and PO routing

Hi Samir / Acquitech team,

Welcome — we're looking forward to getting Acquitech set up in our vendor registry so we can route purchase orders and invoices to the right places. To complete your profile in our system we need the following items:

- Legal entity name exactly as registered (for tax and contract).
- Registered/legal address (street, city, country).
- Tax classification / TIN (or W-8BEN if foreign entity).
- Primary invoice email and PO contact (name + email + phone).
- Preferred remittance method and banking details (bank name, account name, IBAN/SWIFT or wire instructions).
- Point of contact for onboarding (who we should reach for procurement / AP).

I've attached a short vendor intake checklist and a wire instruction template to show the fields we need. You can also fill the intake form here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cAcquitech-Vendor-Intake.

A couple of notes on PO routing from our side: by default POs are issued from procurement@redwood.ai. For invoices to be matched automatically, the PO number should appear in the invoice subject or body and the invoice should be sent to invoices@redwood.ai. If you need a different routing (e.g., AP@ or a marketplace flow) let us know and we'll map it.

Can you send the items above and the signed W-8/W-9 as applicable? If any of these are confidential, feel free to share the bank details over the secure wire template attached.

Thanks — I’ve CC'd Monica (AP) and Markus (Legal) so they can confirm tax/contract items as needed.

Next step: once we have the docs, Monica will create the vendor record and confirm the Redwood vendor code and PO lane.

Best,

Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Acquitech_Company_Profile.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: wire-template.pdf (application/pdf)]

On Wed, Apr 1, 2026 at 03:03 PM Samir Patel <samir.patel@acquitech.com> wrote:
> Attached are our company profile and the completed tax form (W-8BEN)...

Next steps from our side:
- Monica (AP) will create the vendor record and assign a Redwood vendor code (we typically return the vendor code within 48 business hours).
- Please return the completed wire-template.pdf with bank account name, account number/IBAN, SWIFT/BIC and a bank contact if available. We accept passworded PDFs or secure upload via that Drive link — whichever your security team prefers.
- I’m attaching a short PO-routing-template (spreadsheet) that our procurement team uses to map PO vs invoice lanes. Please confirm the following entries in the sheet: invoice address, PO contact email, whether invoices require a PO number for auto-match, and whether you accept emailed invoices to invoices@redwood.ai.

PO routing highlights:
- Standard flow: PO issued from procurement@redwood.ai -> invoices to invoices@redwood.ai for automated matching.
- Marketplace or channel sales: invoices may go to partner-invoices@redwood.ai and require a different vendor code — please flag if this applies.
- High-value invoices (> 50,000 USD): require PO and approval chain; include GL code if provided.

Attachments: PO-routing-template.xlsx (please return with the completed sheet).

Monica and Markus — can you confirm the vendor code once created and any legal flags on the W-8? Markus, if you need anything further from Samir on entity docs let us know.

Karthik
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Samir — thanks for moving quickly. If you upload today we should be able to accept our first PO next week.

Cheers,

Monica Patel
